news.headline: Govt to end slab system punishing power consumers crossing 200-unit threshold
news.summary:
<p>ISLAMABAD: Power Minister Awais Leghari told the Senate on Tuesday that the government has decided to scrap the electricity slab system that punishes consumers for crossing the 200-unit threshold even by one unit, and to provide targeted subsidy only to those deserving.</p>

news.headline: Hegseth Swears In Air Force General After Vaccine-Mandated Early Retirement
news.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth welcomed Air Force Brig. Gen. Melissa S. Cunningham back into the Air Force during a swearing-in ceremony at the Pentagon. Cunningham was forced to retire from service in 2022 after declining to take the military's then-mandatory COVID-19 vaccination.
